scope: One fixed offline residual calibration candidate on existing PP records only. No simulations, action branches, new labels or independent confirmation.
cohort: cohort.json copied from tsc_corridor_arrival_transfer_20261107; other-city donor 8h, each target adaptation block 2h, three disjoint blocks, two dev seeds per block; own donor cannot train own target.
baseline: Current remaining detector distance / observed past 10s same-straight-lane progress speed; exact original fallback to speed limit for unavailable/nonpositive history. Nonstraight physical indicator is zero.
training_unit: Every moving flight at observable matched non-spillback decisions with full future10s; current and previous state only; snapshot weighting matches deployment risk-set evaluation.
labels: 11 categories: first observed straight detector arrival at relative seconds1..10, or category0=no straight detector arrival within10s; competing/terminal/end-of-hour censored retained when full10s is observed.
model: Conditional 11-category histogram. F_head(h)=(20*B(h)+sum_k<=h count[k])/(20+n). B is continuous physical ETA indicator. Empirical part is stepwise at integer observed times, evaluated directly at real bounds.

arms.S: 0.5 target head +0.5 true other-city donor head
arms.P: 0.5 target head +0.5 physically stratified permuted other-city donor head

missing_cells: Target missing ->physical baseline; source missing ->S=P=T. Source support never changes T.
placebo: Within source edge x seed x physical ETA bin x current lane, shuffle complete future10s label category. Preserve baseline physical relation and marginal labels, break extra queue/history condition association.
decoder: Unique primary decoder: F(h)>=0.5 means arrived. Fixed once, no threshold search or alternative soft decoder. Aligns per-vehicle absolute-loss indicator; does not guarantee aggregate count MAE optimum.
decision: Original queue base plus threshold-decoded accumulated arrivals during legal protected seconds. Query each flight detector CDF at h-tail_s, preserving continuous physical ETA. Original round12/first feasible tie and GP fallback.
primary_scoring: Original common-scored dev set (old ArrivalPolicy filter), next10s detector count MAE per edge epoch, then six-seed equal mean per city.
secondary_scoring: All observable matched non-spillback moving risk-set epochs, reported separately, not substituted for primary.
reproduction_gate: Every one of12 original common edge denominators, analytic MAE and historical-speed MAE must match expected_baselines.json within1e-12.
development_signal_gate: Both cities: S equal-seed MAE below T, P and fixed history baseline, and executable request differences S/T and S/P each in>=2 of6devseeds. Report all seeds and blocks, no model/threshold/city/seed changes after results.
stopping: Failure ->HOLD_RESIDUAL_DEVELOPMENT. Even if passed, no automatic branch/simulation launch; this phase measures prediction and request differences only.
execution: jtl110gpu2, existing server-side records. Pull compact JSON only; no raw trajectories or checkpoints to local disk.
